title: Ring pulse runs ~16x slower than the documented ~1.2/2.5 Hz — code contradicts its own comments and art-direction §6.1
evidence: view.odin:338 "	step: u32 = 16 // slow amber pulse ~1.25 Hz @ 20 Hz logic"; view.odin:342 "		step = 8 // fast critical pulse ~2.5 Hz"; view.odin:212 "	idx := (tick + u64(node_id) * 5) / u64(step) & 15"; view.odin:208 "// the per-state rate (amber 1 tick/step = 1.25 Hz, red 2 ticks/step = 2.5 Hz"; epic-4-context.md:34-35 "the ring pulse rate is itself the escalation signal: slow ~1.2 Hz strained, fast ~2.5 Hz critical)."
detail: idx advances once per `step` ticks, so PULSE16 cycles in 16×step ticks: amber step=16 → 256 ticks (12.8 s, 0.078 Hz), red step=8 → 128 ticks (0.156 Hz) — 16× slower than the documented ~1.2/2.5 Hz.
recommended_fix: Set the step constants so a cycle is 16–32 ticks (e.g. amber step=2, red step=1 → 0.625/1.25 Hz, red still 2× faster) and correct the Hz claims in both comments (2.5 Hz is impossible for a 16-entry table).

title: Run-HUD still instructs "deliver a packet to win" in the goal-0/cap-0 4.1 sandbox, where winning is impossible and the Game_Over toasts are unreachable
evidence: app/main.odin:32 "WIN_GOAL :: u32(0)            // 0 = win/lose disabled (4.1 session)"; app/main.odin:33 "LOSE_TICK_CAP :: u64(0)       // 0 = no cap (4.1 session)"; app/main.odin:533 "draw_text(app, \"draw source->router->sink; deliver a packet to win\", 12, 36, 16, p.ink_soft)"
detail: With goal 0 and cap 0 the terminal never latches, so the instruction promises a win the shipped session cannot deliver, and the Game_Over toast/retry branch in draw_hud is dead in the launchable.
recommended_fix: Reword the instruction for the sandbox (e.g. "draw source->router->sink; oversubscribe to see the strain telegraph") or drop the win clause; leave the toasts to 4.3.
